terms.grammar: adjective, with mēnsis; also a masculine noun (sc. mēnsis)
terms.comment: Kalendae, Nōnae, Īdūs Jūniae: the 1st, 5th and 13th. Jūniō alone also means “in June” (see month).

phrases.latin: nam Taurus propter nivēs ante mēnsem Jūnium trānsīrī nōn potest
phrases.english: for the Taurus mountains cannot be crossed before June because of the snow
